releaseNotes: Polished Racing Dashboard & Refined Speedometer: 1) Silky-smooth spring-damped needle & gauge animation with physical inertia for real GPS speed changes. 2) Subtle multi-tier bezel depth with lens reflection sheen, sunken dial shadow, and concentric guide groove. 3) Seamless chromatic transitions across low (electric cyan), medium (azure), and high (racing amber to redline crimson) speed zones. 4) Daylight & night high-contrast visibility with pure white numerals and non-fatiguing OLED dark depth. 5) Responsive layout preventing phone screen clipping. 6) Optimized rendering performance with pre-allocated text paints to conserve battery.
